page_title: REI 2-0 LYO | Reims v Lyon 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) on for Keito Nakamura.
87' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
87' Clinton Mata (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
85' Thibault De Smet (Reims) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

83' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Reims are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
80' William Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oumar Diakite (Reims) replacing Mohamed Daramy.
79' The referee blows his whistle as Junya Ito (Reims) was too aggressive in his challenge.
78' A substitution has been made. Nicolas Tagliafico is replaced by Henrique (Lyon).
78' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Sael Kumbedi and he is replaced by Jeffinho (Lyon).
77' Teddy Teuma comes off the pitch to be replaced by Amir Richardson (Reims).
74' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:9.
71' 2 - 0 Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
70' The corner is swung in but Reims can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Fabio Grosso is forced to make a change. Mama Balde is unable to continue due to injury, Tino Kadewere (Lyon) comes on.
68' Mama Balde (Lyon) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
66' The game is interrupted now, Mama Balde (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' The ball is cleared after Mama Balde (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
62' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Junya Ito (Reims) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
60' Teddy Teuma (Reims) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
59' Mama Balde (Lyon) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
57' Reims show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
55' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Corentin Tolisso is replaced by Johann Lepenant (Lyon).
53' It's time for a substitution. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) comes on in place of Rayan Cherki.
52' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
50' A cross into the box from Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is cleared.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lyon.
46' Referee Francois Letexier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 1 - 0 Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets on the end of a fine cross and heads the ball into the top right corner!
45+1' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
43' Junya Ito (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Shots on target – 0:2.
39' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Reims take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
35' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
33' Thibault De Smet (Reims) was too forceful with his tackle and Francois Letexier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
30' Thibault De Smet (Reims) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
28' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sinaly Diomande (Lyon).
24' Teddy Teuma (Reims) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Thibault De Smet (Reims) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
20' Junya Ito (Reims) controls a cross from Teddy Teuma inside the box, but sidefoots the ball just over the bar.
17' Sinaly Diomande (Lyon) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
15' Handball by Keito Nakamura (Reims).
13' Dangerous play by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon). Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
11' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
9' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
4' Rough tackle by Teddy Teuma (Reims). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

2' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francois Letexier with no other option than to blow for a foul.
